_about: Animation A1: timing-style profiles for the in-betweener (the two motion reels compare them). Times are in 60 Hz ticks unless named otherwise. Render only, outside the sim's data hash; never moves a part's contact tick, only how the motion is spread inside its window.

by_part._note: Orb's mix (2026-10-01 playtest): snappy for light blows, rushes and chains, fluid for heavy and power blows and for launches. A forced style (--anim-style, tools) overrides it for every part.

snappy._note: held poses and hard snaps, animated on twos

fluid._note: eased in-betweens, long overlap, animated on ones
